name: Paranormal Files: Fatal Flaw Collector's Edition
detailed_description:
Elephant Games brings you the newest spine-tingling investigation in the Paranormal Files series!

When Professor Stines is attacked by his colleague Lillian, he knows he needs a specialist. Because not only did the attack come out of nowhere, but Lillian is dead! So, what’s a guy to do when dealing with the not-so-dearly departed? Call Rick Rogers, of course! Fresh off his last case, Rick’s right back to work following the trail of this extremely powerful and dangerous spirit. But why would a ghost go after a mere acquaintance, and what about Corrigale College’s history could cause such a phenomenon? Join Rick for this chilling Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure to find out!

This is a special Collector's Edition </span> release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:

  • Something paranormal and dangerous is changing people's luck at the Casino, and Rachel needs her special skills to stop it!

  • Play and re-play mini-games and HOPs, earn Achievements, collect all the hidden Artifacts, and find puzzle pieces to enter Secret Room!

  • Download unique wallpapers, music, and more!

  • Steer clear of those pesky poltergeists with the helpful Strategy Guide!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.
